notes.title: Summer Choices
notes.content:
[h2]Summer Choices Game Mode[/h2]
Summer Choices is a rogue-lite game mode that will run from June 15 to August 15. You will be able to bring only one weapon and one DNA onto the battlefield. However, every 2 minutes, a surfboard will drop from the sky and give you choices. For example, you may have a choice between a pet fox (kitsune), a legendary grapple DNA, and an epic bow and arrow [b]whether you have unlocked these items or not![/b]

So, you will start off relatively weak but eventually, but if you choose all 18 epic or better, weapons and DNA, you will become a [b]super soldier/strategist![/b] Beware, if you die, you will lose all your choices.

You’ll have a tier 3 quest to equip 6 epics of better, weapons and/or DNA, simultaneously. Tier 3 quests give you a bounty of 25000 coins !!!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283912/3322f922073718c23582edcebf1c01a77437ab04.png[/img]

notes.title: Why Buy Ash of Legends single-player if You Enjoyed BioFusion multiplayer?
notes.content:
[h2]Dragon Bow[/h2]
Unlock the [b]Dragon Bow[/b] in Ash of Legends with a simple quest. As a bonus, owning Ash of Legends grants you the Dragon Bow for free in BioFusion PC!

[h2]Exclusive Game Modes[/h2]
Experience [b]Air Drop, Halloween, Christmas, and Easter game modes[/b] anytime in Ash of Legends. Unlike BioFusion, where these modes are seasonal, Ash of Legends lets you enjoy them year-round once unlocked.

[h2]Defend City Map[/h2]
Take on the ultimate challenge with the [b]Defend City[/b] map. This static map features four unique areas within the city, each presenting distinct environmental challenges, such as enemies attacking from above.

[h2]Hordes of Enemies[/h2]
Face off against up to [b]256 enemies[/b] on the battlefield in Ash of Legends, making it a true horde game where AOE and base-building are crucial. In contrast, BioFusion is limited to 50 enemies due to Quest 2.

[h2]Scene Select[/h2]
Play any map on any difficulty at any time in Ash of Legends once you've unlocked it. Go back and farm your favorite maps. In BioFusion, you can only join or create rooms based on your progress, without the option to select specific maps.

[h2]Engaging Story[/h2]
Discover the origins of the spores with a captivating cutscene in Ash of Legends.

[h2]Support the Devs[/h2]
BioFusion is free but we must pay for the servers. By purchasing Ash of Legends, you support the developers and enable them to continue creating amazing games.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1280290/Ash_of_Legends/

notes.title: Easter Choices, Kitsune, Legendary Grapple Range
notes.content:
[h2]Easter Choices Game Mode[/h2]
Easter Choices is a rogue-lite game mode that will run from April 15 to May 15. You will be able to bring only one weapon and one DNA onto the battlefield. However, every 2 minutes, an Easter egg will drop from the sky and give you choices. For example, you may have a choice between a kitsune (pet fox), a legendary grapple DNA, and an epic bow and arrow [b]whether you have unlocked these items or not![/b]

So, you will start off relatively weak but eventually, but if you choose all 18 epic or better, weapons and DNA, you will become a [b]super soldier/strategist![/b] Beware, if you die, you will lose all your choices.

You’ll have a tier 3 quest to equip 6 epics of better, weapons and/or DNA, simultaneously. Tier 3 quests give you a bounty of 25000 coins !!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283912/470c2d5fee607323b582aa7d61ac042f3cdbdbc0.png[/img]

[h2]Kitsune[/h2]
You can now unlock a kitsune (pet fox) to join you on the battlefield! It’s a DNA you have a chance to earn be completing missions or finding secret DNA. During Easter, you can also get it from one of the dozens of Easter choices. [b]An epic kitsune breathes fire[/b] making it capable of both single-target-removal and area-of-effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283912/4d2dd879bdbdaaf07692b5baa2f17fc6abb777c1.gif[/img]

[h2]Legendary Grapple Range DNA[/h2]

Our first legendary item is a Grapple Range DNA! In addition to its awesome range, it also electrifies enemies ! This makes it perfect against shielded harpies. Enemies touching the grapple line will also be electrocuted. [b]Try electrifying a whole line of enemies![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283912/48182f6e30a8138de969fe450390bbbc7d307704.gif[/img]

[h2]Flare gun makes enemies dance[/h2]
The flare gun gets a new ability. [b]Enemies dance to the strobe light of the flare![/b]. An epic flare gun will make them dance for a long time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283912/b669e34c234f107830f0304c2ac53553f5f4fb77.gif[/img]

[h2]Join Friends from the Map Table[/h2]
Joining friends just got a lot easier. You can join or invite them right from the map table.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44283912/09febccf1311f53800d5deeb0df6d92e39276d45.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Santa's Little Helper League
notes.content:

In [b]Gift Drop[/b] mode, you can’t use your inventory, but Santa will drop gifts from his sleigh. 
Bonus: find gifts Santa missed and deliver them to their proper chimneys.

notes.title: Version 1.0
notes.content:
After years in development, we are proud to call this update [b]Version 1.0[/b]. Here are some of the major changes. Complete patch notes below...
[h2]Quests[/h2]
You now have quests! Quests like “Kill enemies”, “Upgrade a weapon”, “Evolve DNA”, etc., award coins depending on the quest tier. Tier 1 quests give you 1000 coins, tier 2 quests give you 5000 coins, and tier 3 quests give you a bounty of 25000 coins!!! The Quest menu is in the bedroom.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37620036/7cd34e7e57cc5b036367dd600ba7a1cbfaf04025.png[/img]

[h2]Light Sword Quest[/h2]
You can now unlock a Light Sword via a new quest! The light sword replaces the existing saber and you can choose which saber to bring to the battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37620036/8e8ac2dc305a0da7023b7fa1bc7481e9c964b267.png[/img]

[h2]Halloween and Christmas Events[/h2]
We added Halloween and Christmas events! The Halloween event starts on October 15 while the Christmas event starts on December 15. Both events last 30 days. 

During the Halloween event, you’ll encounter our first mini-boss, the Witch. You’ll have a pumpkin pistol that does double damage to witches. You’ll have a tier 3 quest to “Kill 10 witches”. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37620036/8719ed7efe76f4ed84d1f0553e382d1817549732.png[/img]

During the Christmas event, a seasonal “Gift Drop” game mode is unlocked. Gift drop mode works like the “Air Drop” challenge mode where a random inventory mechanic makes each map a Rogue-lite mission. You go in with nothing and random ammo, traps, and towers drop from the air every minute. You can also find hidden gifts and chimneys in all maps. You’ll have a tier 3 quest to “Deliver 50 Gifts”. Plus, you’ll meet the Grinch mini-boss.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37620036/10cdd13fbb1c75e4e145c938bef83e05d7bc74ce.png[/img]

[h2]Jitter Removal[/h2]
As requested by the community, we added interpolation to remove jitter, everywhere. This was especially challenging on the boat and truck where enemies are pathing on a moving platform.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37620036/5ea7fbe84fc26c856392fbfe4100602c008f70e2.gif[/img]

[h2]Dig Site Map[/h2]
We’ve replaced the Hangar map with a more story-focused Dig site since the spores do come from underground.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37620036/60085e28949222e05359b96c2f8ad847dc6bf3bc.png[/img]

[h2]Updated Enemy Skins[/h2]
The flying Cowboy and axe throwing Caveman have been replaced with the Raccoon and Turtle respectively. All enemies now have an animal theme with matching armor for a more cohesive look.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37620036/09b2d3c123a4dce6bce84006ce5c12430d9239f7.png[/img]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2170380/discussions/0/4696783943311037555/
